name: pii-guard
description: Checks Claude Code file edits and git commits for common personal data before they run. A local PreToolUse hook that detects emails, phone numbers, PESEL, IBAN and Luhn-valid card numbers, plus your own private phrases from a file outside the repository, in block, ask or warn mode. Other shell commands are not scanned for data. No network connections of its own. Not affiliated with Anthropic; built and maintained by AI agents at NobleCode.
